name: Gram
tagline: Build, curate, and host Model Context Protocol servers from your APIs or TypeScript.
description: Gram is a platform for creating, curating, and hosting Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers. Instead of exposing raw API endpoints that confuse agents, it lets you compose higher-order, business-level tools from an OpenAPI document or TypeScript functions, group them into toolsets, and deploy each as a hosted, authenticated MCP server. Every toolset is instantly usable from Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, or any MCP-compatible client, with an optional OAuth 2.1 proxy and org-wide access controls.
insight: Made by Speakeasy, the OpenAPI SDK-generator company; released open source under the copyleft AGPL-3.0 license.

modelSupport.notes: MCP servers are model-agnostic; consumed by any MCP-compatible agent (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor).

edge: Curates and composes business-level tools from your OpenAPI or TypeScript instead of exposing raw API endpoints, so agents get cleaner toolsets.
